scope: Read-only code review; no model, GPU, corpus scan, actual checkpoint or runtime test. Root activation review remains required.
verified: Original foundation budget SHA pins exact diagnostic JSON, corpus manifest and validation-block inventory; Corpus verifies original shard bytes.
Frozen document_losses uses all 256 FP32 length512 blocks; frozen language_diagnostics preserves 32 binary two-member pairs and 32 greedy continuations up to48 tokens including early EOT.
Masked pair targets count answer positions; input and attention count full prefix+answer contexts. Raw generation reserves one target but full growing input context per forward.
Whole worst-case token/input/attention/time reservations persist after failure and early EOT. Per-forward reserves precede forward invocation.
Request binds exact accepted checkpoint bytes, signed paused campaign, committed cursor, latest inventory, immutable protocol and own initialization. Root decision is separate.

practical_findings.finding: No AC check in evaluator worker or launcher, and protocol does not state AC. Existing guards.Guard only logs battery; cannot claim inherited AC enforcement.
practical_findings.recommendation: If AC is mandatory, explicitly require/check before allocation and at periodic resource checks.

practical_findings.finding: completed_forward event is emitted immediately after asynchronous MPS forward returns, before explicit device synchronization. Frozen CE/item synchronizes later, so completed final result remains credible but interrupted journal completion is overstated.
practical_findings.recommendation: Rename event to dispatched_forward or synchronize before completion event.

practical_findings.finding: Protocol pins Python executable and code bytes, but neither verifies nor records actual Torch/NumPy versions.
practical_findings.recommendation: Pin reviewed package versions and record them in receipt before first real evaluation.

other_limits: Attention elements intentionally omit head/layer multipliers and are documented as sequence attention cells.
Root must inspect both completed result and clean watchdog receipt before decision; evaluator does not issue acceptance.
